asked.item: Did I put the skills in the wrong place (~/.claude/skills) for Cowork?
Do the skills only work for coders?
How to get content-coach to show up in Cowork

verdict.reason: The help pages state that Cowork does not read the ~/.claude/skills folder and give the personal-account ZIP upload route for Cowork, which answers the placement question and the content-coach setup.

steps.text: Cowork does not read the ~/.claude/skills folder, so the copies you put there will not show up in Cowork; for Cowork, use the personal-account upload route instead.
Package only the content-coach folder as a ZIP containing its SKILL.md and support files, and do not upload the entire 8-skill pack as one skill.
In Claude, open Customize > Skills, select +, then + Create skill, and then select Upload a skill.
Upload the content-coach ZIP, enable the uploaded skill, and then start a conversation using the same Claude account.
If upload is unavailable, check Anthropic's account and organization requirements.
